candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(callResult) check so withdrawAll no longer reverts when the external call fails.
Remove the reset of credit[msg.sender] to 0, allowing repeated withdrawals of the same credit.
Move the external call before the balance and credit state updates, reintroducing a reentrancy window where state has not yet been updated when receive() executes.
Delete the statement that zeroes the caller's credit, so credit is not reset after withdrawal.
Change `balance -= oCredit;` to `balance += oCredit;` so the contract balance is increased instead of decreased.
Change `require(callResult);` to `require(!callResult);` so the transaction reverts when the transfer succeeds and succeeds when it fails.
Change `credit[msg.sender] = 0;` to `credit[msg.sender] = oCredit;` so the credit is preserved rather than zeroed.
Change the guard `if (oCredit > 0)` to `if (oCredit > 1)` so a caller with exactly one wei of credit can no longer withdraw.
Delete the `balance -= oCredit;` statement so the contract's balance is not decremented on withdrawal.
